messages:
mira: quick check — for the next rollout, are we leaning proto-first at the gateway or a router-shim that transcodes to JSON for internal services? need perf + telemetry tradeoffs. ping @devon @sam

devon: proto-first gives stronger typing and fewer runtime transcoding surprises, but it forces client changes and http2 everywhere. ops complexity goes up.

sam: shim is lower friction for product teams (web/mobile keep json) but we saw header-loss and quota mismatches in the POC. also slightly higher p95 on small rpcs.

chris: agree with sam. core issue was claim propagation and trace continuity. if we can't guarantee headers/claims survive the shim, quota+billing gets fuzzy.

mira: do we have perf signals from the spike? rough numbers fine.

devon: from local spike: proto-first (http2) lowered avg CPU by ~8% on serving nodes, and reduced tail jitter. shim added ~1.0–1.5ms median and bumped 95p by ~3–5ms for small payloads. numbers vary by route.

sam: telemetry note: shim also increased error-class 'quota-mismatch' in 0.2% of requests — mostly when auth libs strip unknown headers.

mira: could mitigate by route-level fast-paths + opt-in header to skip transcoding when client already speaks proto. also a small sdk shim to set headers for browsers.

chris: proposal: default -> shim (no client changes). enable 'proto' fast-path per-route/tenant via header x-rw-proto=true. control-plane exposes canary toggle per-tenant. tracing adds tag edge.transcoded=true when shim used.

mira: sketch of route config we can put in the gateway catalog:

```
routes:
  - path: /v1/generate
    method: POST
    allow_proto_fastpath: true
    claim_map:
      tenant_id: x-tenant-id
      route_id: x-route
```

sam: concerns: relying on clients to set x-rw-proto is brittle. need fallback: auto-detect based on content-type or early-negotiation. also ensure auth libs don't drop x-* headers.

devon: add control-plane feature: per-tenant flag + weight for canary. console UX should show canary % + p95 delta + quota-mismatch-rate + header-drop-rate.

mira: telemetry list for rollout dashboard: p50/p95 latency, error rate, quota-mismatch-rate, header-drop-rate, transcode_duration_ms. also example eval prompts to validate output parity (small prompt corpus).

chris: i'll set up metrics: add counter edge.transcoded_count, gauge edge.transcode_duration_ms, tag header_present:true/false. dashboard tile: header-drop > 0.1% -> alert.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: edgerouter-shim-v2 -> group alpha (20%) at 3623456798 :rocket:

sam: ok plan from infra side: 1) rollout shim default with opt-in header 2) console flag to flip per-tenant 3) tracing + metrics + alert 4) run canary 20% then evaluate signals -> full rollout or rollback

mira: thanks — i'll open the PR with routing config + console flag mockups and link RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfc/edge-shim. will include the eval corpus.

chris: ack. i'll add dashboard draft and wire alerts.

mira: rough owners: mira (routing config + PR), chris (telemetry + dashboard), sam (sdk/edge detection), devon (ops + canary policy).

sam: one last note — add a tiny integration test that asserts claim headers survive a shim hop. saved us before.

mira: good call. i'll add it to the PR checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
